title: Apply Tangential Impact Impulse to Ball and Club Translation
body:
## Problem

Friction updated ball spin but omitted matching tangential linear impulse, making oblique launch follow face exactly.

## Acceptance Criteria

Correct equal-and-opposite ball/club impulse; preserve momentum, restitution, and energy.

## Validation

tests/unit/physics/test_impact_tangential_impulse.py; tests/unit/physics/test_impact_central_contact_review.py

## Handoff

Branch: `codex/shot-pattern-analysis`. Current implementation and evidence are tracked in `docs/research/shot_pattern_analysis/issues/README.md`. Keep open until a merged implementing PR satisfies acceptance criteria or an explicitly permitted disposition applies.
